description: Full-text search across the titles, short definitions and main keywords of Blck Alpaca's Knowledge Base articles (SEO, GEO, AI agents, marketing automation). Returns matches with URL and path triple; get_knowledge_article fetches the full text.

locale.description: Content language. Untranslated content is left out, never replaced with German.

query.description: Search term, 2 to 100 characters. Fewer than two characters return an empty result list.

name: search_knowledge_base

articleRef.description: Path triple; pass it to get_knowledge_article as is.

title: Search the Knowledge Base
